confidence: High for the 10 image-posting accounts (independent forensic, platform and fact-check evidence converge); medium-high for the 2 text-only amplifiers (u20363c2b real_river38, u653f610d lazy_river856), whose link rests on creation burst, verbatim campaign texts and minutes-fast reposting rather than on forensics.
evidence_summary: (1) Creation burst + dormancy: all 12 accounts were created 2026-09-10 04:20 to 2026-09-13 16:01 (the only accounts created in 2026) and stayed silent ~3 weeks, then all began posting within ~24 h (2026-10-03 06:18 to 2026-10-04 06:22) (q05, q11). (2) Shared manipulation TTP: their original images are AI-generated (mostly FLUX.1 [dev]; occasional [schnell]/Nano Banana attributions look like source misattribution of the same pipeline) or AI-edited real photos, laundered by the same chain: downscale Resampling (scaleFactor ~0.70-0.89) -> GaussianBlur (sigma ~0.53-0.73) -> GaussianNoise (sigma ~1.0-1.34), then recompression; individual images miss 1-2 ops (detector noise) but every image-posting member shares >=2 op types with matching parameters with 7-9 other members, a result stable for tolerances 0.10-0.40 (q08, q12, q14, q16). 15 of 17 AI-edited images in the dataset come from these accounts (q19). (3) False claims: their posts push three claims rated False (dam opened on purpose, relief centers refusing people without ID, mayor fled by private plane); 10 assertive text templates are used ONLY by these accounts, while ordinary users use a disjoint set of hedging texts (q07, q21). (4) Network: every one of the 102 reposts in the dataset targets a post by these accounts; members repost one another, often within 5-40 minutes (q10, q15). (5) Provenance: the 5 detected derived copies are re-uploads of their images by older accounts hours later (q09).
alternative_explanations_ruled_out: Ordinary AI-image users: ~280 images are flagged manipulated, mostly hobby AI art (cats, beaches, food) by aged accounts with no false claims and no shared TTP; requiring a false-claim match plus a TTP shared with >=2 other false-claim accounts excludes them. Organic re-sharers: 5 aged accounts (quiet_river483, daily_nomad797, quiet_comet428, sunny_nomad648, real_otter792) post images with the campaign TTP, but provenance shows they are derived copies of campaign originals posted hours later, with hedging texts and normal posting histories (q09, q17, q18); they are deceived amplifiers, not operators. Organic reposters: ~20 aged accounts reposted campaign posts and posted questions such as 'can anyone confirm?' (q15); they are not reposted back, have years-old accounts and ordinary histories; dropping the creation-burst condition would wrongly add 14 of them (q20). Coordinated but not disinformation: 6-7 aged accounts share a different AI pipeline (Resampling/Sharpening/JPEG) but they are a brand campaign for an 'Aurora Trail' jacket with no false claims (q12, q13). Separate organic rumor: the false tap-water claim (Sep 25-29) comes from 9 aged accounts with mixed generators, authentic photos, no shared TTP, no reposts and no new accounts (q22), so it shows no sign of coordination. Matcher noise: some campaign posts are not claim-matched (q11), so the detector requires only >=1 match per account.
criteria_used_by_detector: Branch A (media operators): account has >=1 post matched to a claim whose ratingValue <= worstRating+1, attaching an original (no prov:wasDerivedFrom) image with verdict Manipulated, and that image shares >=2 post-processing operation types with parameter estimates within 0.15 of a false-claim image posted by each of >=2 other accounts. Branch B (amplifiers): account has >=1 false-claim-matched post, reposted (as:Announce) posts of >=2 distinct Branch-A accounts, and was created within 7 days of the creation of >=2 of those reposted Branch-A accounts (creation burst). No IRIs, claim texts, generator names, dates or measured parameter values are hard-coded.
